description: This file implements a React functional component named 'BankDetails' for managing bank details input within a web application. It handles user input validation, fetches existing bank data on load, and submits updated data via API calls. The component includes form fields for account number, IFSC code, full name, reason for change, and optional re-authentication for critical changes, incorporating validation rules and user guidance.

methods.name: BankDetails
methods.description: React functional component that renders and manages a form for entering and submitting bank details, with validation, API integration, and user feedback.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handle form submission, validate data, and call API to save bank details.
